book.anima.codex.gods.name: Gods & Worship
book.anima.codex.gods.description: Collect God Souls, build shrines and use a Priest Rod.
book.anima.codex.spells.name: Spell List
book.anima.codex.spells.description: Look up soul costs, cooldowns and casting notes.
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.name: Collect a God Soul
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.goal: Finish a God Soul source with a Saronite Sword while carrying a bottle.
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.p0.title: Prepare the sword and bottle
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.p0.text:
Craft a Saronite Sword and carry an empty glass bottle. Use the sword for the killing strike on an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian or summoned god avatar.\
\
Each successful harvest fills one bottle. Arrows cannot collect God Souls. Without a bottle, no soul is left behind.
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.p1.title: Choose what to make
book.anima.codex.gods.god_soul.p1.text:
One God Soul lets you create a god at a Deity Fabricator. Five are needed for a Ring of Power: four on plinths and one offered at the Infusion Table.\
\
God Souls cannot enter a Soul Well, work in machines or be extracted with a Bone Cage. You can worship another player’s god without making one.
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_golem.go: Look up the cost and effect of Animate Golem.
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_golem.p0:
Cost: 1 Wise, 1 Predatory, 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 180 seconds.\
\
Animate an earth or stone block into a golem ally for 3 minutes.
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_golem.p1:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at an earth or stone block within 12 blocks. It consumes that block; leave room above for the ally.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_golem.p2:
The ally follows you and fights nearby hostiles or creatures you fight. It avoids you, your pets and your other allies. It lasts three minutes.\
\
Summoned creatures cannot be caged or harvested for souls. The spell's three-minute cooldown limits repeated summons.
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_spider.g: Look up the cost and effect of Animate Spider.
book.anima.codex.spells.animate_spider.p:
Cost: 1 Predatory.\
Cooldown: 180 seconds.\
\
Animate an earth or stone block into a spider ally for 3 minutes.

Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at an earth or stone block within 12 blocks. It consumes that block; leave room above for the ally.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).

The ally follows you and fights nearby hostiles or creatures you fight. It avoids you, your pets and your other allies. It lasts three minutes.\
\
Summoned creatures cannot be caged or harvested for souls. The spell's three-minute cooldown limits repeated summons.
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.name: Blink
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Blink.
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.p0.title: Blink
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Ender.\
Cooldown: 3 seconds.\
\
Teleport up to 24 blocks in the direction you aim.
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.blink.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim for a destination with space for your body. The spell checks room to arrive, but can place you in midair. Choose a landing spot or prepare flight.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.detonate.name: Detonate
book.anima.codex.spells.detonate.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Detonate.
book.anima.codex.spells.detonate.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Unhinged, 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Create an explosion where you aim. It damages creatures without breaking blocks.
book.anima.codex.spells.detonate.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at least five blocks away, within 32 blocks. The blast damages creatures but does not break terrain.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.doom_bolt.name: Doom Bolt
book.anima.codex.spells.doom_bolt.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Doom Bolt.
book.anima.codex.spells.doom_bolt.p0.tex:
Cost: 1 Doomed.\
Cooldown: 4 seconds.\
\
Fire a wither skull.
book.anima.codex.spells.doom_bolt.p1.tex:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aims a wither-skull projectile along your view. Line up a clear shot before casting.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.drain_life.name: Drain Life
book.anima.codex.spells.drain_life.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Drain Life.
book.anima.codex.spells.drain_life.p0.te:
Cost: 1 Predatory, 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Deal 4 hearts of damage and heal up to 3 hearts from the damage dealt.
book.anima.codex.spells.drain_life.p1.te:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at a creature within 16 blocks. Healing depends on actual damage dealt.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.excavate.name: Excavate
book.anima.codex.spells.excavate.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Excavate.
book.anima.codex.spells.excavate.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Unhinged.\
Cooldown: 1 seconds.\
\
Break a 3×3 face of blocks where you look, as an iron pickaxe would.
book.anima.codex.spells.excavate.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim within six blocks. The spell leaves containers, unbreakable blocks and blocks with hardness 10 or greater intact.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.name: Feast
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Feast.
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.p0.title: Feast
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Restore 8 hunger points and saturation.
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.feast.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Cast when hungry. Eight hunger points fill four drumsticks; a full hunger bar prevents the cast.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.fire_ward.name: Fire Ward
book.anima.codex.spells.fire_ward.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Fire Ward.
book.anima.codex.spells.fire_ward.p0.tex:
Cost: 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Gain Fire Resistance for 5 minutes.
book.anima.codex.spells.fire_ward.p1.tex:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Grants Fire Resistance. It protects against fire and lava, not every attack from a Nether creature.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.fireball.name: Fireball
book.anima.codex.spells.fireball.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Fireball.
book.anima.codex.spells.fireball.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 5 seconds.\
\
Fire three fireballs.
book.anima.codex.spells.fireball.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Fires three small fireballs in a spread along your view. Face your target before casting.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.name: Flight
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Flight.
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.p0.title: Flight
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.p0.text:
Cost: 2 Ender, 1 Predatory.\
Cooldown: 90 seconds.\
\
Fly for 60 seconds, then descend with Slow Falling.
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.flight.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Use normal flight controls. When the timer ends, you receive a safe descent.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
book.anima.codex.spells.frost_nova.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Frost Nova.
book.anima.codex.spells.frost_nova.p0.te:
Cost: 1 Aquatic.\
Cooldown: 15 seconds.\
\
Deal 2 hearts of damage and slow creatures within 6 blocks for 8 seconds; briefly freeze nearby water.
book.anima.codex.spells.frost_nova.p1.te:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Centers on you. Nearby creatures take damage and Slowness III; water within five blocks becomes temporary frosted ice. Leave space around friendly creatures.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.name: Gills
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Gills.
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.p0.title: Gills
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Aquatic.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Breathe underwater and swim faster for 5 minutes.
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.gills.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Grants Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace. Enter water to benefit from the swimming speed.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.name: Growth
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Growth.
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.p0.title: Growth
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 1 seconds.\
\
Bonemeal every crop, sapling and plant within 4 blocks.
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.growth.p1.text:
Known from the start.\
\
Stand near plants that accept bonemeal. This does not accelerate Anima crystal clusters.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.hunters_stride.g: Look up the cost and effect of Hunter's Stride.
book.anima.codex.spells.hunters_stride.p:
Cost: 1 Predatory.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Gain Speed I and Jump Boost I for 5 minutes.

Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Grants Speed I and Jump Boost I. Use it for travel or to keep moving during combat.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
book.anima.codex.spells.incorporeal.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Incorporeal.
book.anima.codex.spells.incorporeal.p0.t:
Cost: 1 Wise, 1 Ender.\
Cooldown: 60 seconds.\
\
Leave a vulnerable body and fly as a ghost for up to 10 minutes without passing through terrain. Right-click to possess; sneak + right-click to leave a host, then again to return to your body.
book.anima.codex.spells.incorporeal.p1.t:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
[Projection controls and body safety](entry://anima:codex/magic/projection).\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.name: Insight
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Insight.
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.p0.title: Insight
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 5 seconds.\
\
Gain 75 experience points.
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.insight.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Grants 75 experience points. The number of levels gained depends on your current experience.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.iron_skin.name: Iron Skin
book.anima.codex.spells.iron_skin.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Iron Skin.
book.anima.codex.spells.iron_skin.p0.tex:
Cost: 1 Predatory, 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 30 seconds.\
\
Resist 20%% of ordinary damage for 90 seconds.
book.anima.codex.spells.iron_skin.p1.tex:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Grants Resistance I. It reduces ordinary incoming damage, but does not make you invulnerable.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.name: Kiln
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Kiln.
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.p0.title: Kiln
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 2 seconds.\
\
Smelt up to 16 items from your offhand using furnace recipes.
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.kiln.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Hold Foci in your main hand and the furnace input in your offhand. Each cast smelts at most sixteen items. Raw Saronite needs a Soul Forge.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.name: Kindle
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Kindle.
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.p0.title: Kindle
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 4 seconds.\
\
Set a creature on fire for 8 seconds, or light a block, candle or campfire.
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.kindle.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at a creature within twelve blocks, or a block within eight. It can light candles and campfires as well as start ordinary fire.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.name: Mend
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Mend.
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.p0.title: Mend
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 15 seconds.\
\
Heal 4 hearts.
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.mend.p1.text:
Known from the start.\
\
You must be injured. Four hearts is the maximum healing, limited by your missing health.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.might.name: Might
book.anima.codex.spells.might.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Might.
book.anima.codex.spells.might.p0.title: Might
book.anima.codex.spells.might.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Predatory.\
Cooldown: 30 seconds.\
\
Gain Strength I and Haste II for 90 seconds.
book.anima.codex.spells.might.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.might.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Strength helps melee combat; Haste helps mining. The spell gives both at once.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.name: Purify
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Purify.
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.p0.title: Purify
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Remove harmful effects from yourself.
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.purify.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Removes harmful effects while keeping beneficial ones. If you have nothing to cleanse, the cast is refused.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.name: Quench
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Quench.
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.p0.title: Quench
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Aquatic.\
Cooldown: 2 seconds.\
\
Put out fires within 5 blocks, and cool lava into obsidian and cobblestone.
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.quench.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Also extinguishes you. Lava sources become obsidian; flowing lava becomes cobblestone. Aim your position so the lava lies within five blocks.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.name: Reap
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Reap.
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.p0.title: Reap
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Doomed, 1 Predatory.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Deal 8 hearts of damage to the creature you look at. Does not extract its soul.
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.reap.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at a creature within 16 blocks. This spell deals damage only; use a cage or Saronite weapon for soul harvesting.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.name: Recall
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Recall.
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.p0.title: Recall
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Ender, 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 60 seconds.\
\
Return to your bed or respawn point, in whatever dimension it is.
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.recall.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
If your respawn block is missing, you return to world spawn.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.repair_armor.goa: Look up the cost and effect of Repair Armor.
Cost: 1 Wise, 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 30 seconds.\
\
Restore a third of each worn armour piece's durability.
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Only repairs the armor you are wearing, not held tools or spare armor. Equip damaged pieces first. With nothing to repair, no souls are spent.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.name: Repulse
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Repulse.
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.p0.title: Repulse
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Unhinged.\
Cooldown: 5 seconds.\
\
Throw every creature within 6 blocks away from you.
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.repulse.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Centers on you and pushes nearby creatures outward. It is useful when surrounded, but does not distinguish ordinary pets from enemies.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.name: Seeker
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Seeker.
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.p0.title: Seeker
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Ender.\
Cooldown: 3 seconds.\
\
Fire a homing bolt at the creature you aim at, or the nearest hostile creature.
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.seeker.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at a creature within 32 blocks, or toward a hostile creature within 24 blocks.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.name: Shield
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Shield.
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.p0.title: Shield
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 15 seconds.\
\
Negate the next hit within 60 seconds. Does not stack.
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.shield.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
One hit uses the shield, regardless of its size. Recasting while it is ready is refused; watch for the message when it absorbs a hit.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.slingshot.name: Slingshot
book.anima.codex.spells.slingshot.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Slingshot.
book.anima.codex.spells.slingshot.p0.tex:
Cost: 1 Unhinged.\
Cooldown: 5 seconds.\
\
Launch yourself the way you look, with 20 seconds of fall protection.
book.anima.codex.spells.slingshot.p1.tex:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Your view sets the launch direction. Aim before casting and land within the twenty-second fall-protection window.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.slow_fall.name: Slow Fall
book.anima.codex.spells.slow_fall.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Slow Fall.
book.anima.codex.spells.slow_fall.p0.tex:
Cost: 1 Aquatic.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
Gain Slow Falling for 3 minutes.
book.anima.codex.spells.slow_fall.p1.tex:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Cast before a drop to slow your descent and prevent ordinary landing damage while active. It does not grant upward flight.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.name: Smite
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Smite.
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.p0.title: Smite
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Unhinged, 1 Infernal.\
Cooldown: 15 seconds.\
\
Call lightning down where you look.
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.smite.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Aim at a block or creature within 48 blocks. The lightning can affect nearby creatures.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.soul_sight.name: Soul Sight
book.anima.codex.spells.soul_sight.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Soul Sight.
book.anima.codex.spells.soul_sight.p0.te:
Cost: 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 10 seconds.\
\
See in the dark for 5 minutes and outline nearby creatures for 30 seconds.
book.anima.codex.spells.soul_sight.p1.te:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
The outline affects creatures within 32 blocks when cast. Night vision lasts longer than the outline.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.name: Swarm
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Swarm.
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.p0.title: Swarm
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Predatory, 1 Unhinged.\
Cooldown: 20 seconds.\
\
Release soul lights for 15 seconds. They attack nearby creatures, then turn on you when no other valid targets remain.
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.p1.title: Casting notes
book.anima.codex.spells.swarm.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Lights stay active for 15 seconds. When no eligible target remains nearby, they attack you. Allies and protected targets are skipped and do not prevent this backlash.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.tendrils.name: Tendrils
book.anima.codex.spells.tendrils.goal: Look up the cost and effect of Tendrils.
book.anima.codex.spells.tendrils.p0.text:
Cost: 1 Wise.\
Cooldown: 120 seconds.\
\
For 2 minutes, tendrils extend from your back and gather dropped items and experience within 16 blocks.
book.anima.codex.spells.tendrils.p1.text:
Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
Useful after mining or a battle: it brings dropped items and experience orbs to your position. It does not empty containers or draw living creatures.\
\
[Casting basics](entry://anima:codex/magic/casting).
book.anima.codex.spells.vampiric_embrace: Look up the cost and effect of Vampiric Embrace.

Cost: 1 Doomed, 1 Benign.\
Cooldown: 90 seconds.\
\
For 90 seconds, damaging hits have a 25%% chance to heal 1 heart, at most once per second.

Learn it from a translated spell book.\
\
